start.text: Report sent. Ben's laptop is cleaned for now. But a program is not a person, and it might be on other computers too.
start.name: Joshua

A.text: Joshua, I read your report. That fake invoice fooled a lot of people before. Nice work catching it.
A.name: Carla

B.text: The program Ben started was not Ben's doing. It was built to start, hide and spread. So tonight we watch every program that starts.
B.name: Carla

C1.text: By the approved list. Programs from IT or Windows Update are fine. A program nobody approved, that came by email or from a website, is a problem.
C1.name: Carla

C2.text: Not yet. We don't know which computers have it. So we watch, and we find it by its name.
C2.name: Carla

D.text: The rules are in the [b][color=green]rulebook[/color][/b]. [b][color=red]Report[/color][/b] what breaks them, and let the rest pass.
D.name: Carla

E.text: One program at a time. A new name is not always a bad one, so I'll check each rule.
E.name: Joshua
